description: This Java class 'SelfLoansDataValidator' provides validation logic for self-loan related data, including retrieval parameters and loan application JSON validation within the Fineract project. It contains methods for validating retrieved loan requests, transaction retrieval, and loan application submissions, ensuring correct parameter usage and JSON data integrity.

classes.name: SelfLoansDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for self-loan related data, handling validation of retrieval parameters and JSON payloads for loan applications in the Fineract system.

methods.name: validateRetrieveLoan
methods.description: Validates the parameters for retrieving a loan, checking for unsupported association parameters and 'exclude' parameter.

methods.name: validateRetrieveTransaction
methods.description: Validates transaction retrieval parameters, including templates and unsupported parameters.

methods.name: validateLoanApplication
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for loan application, ensuring 'loanType' and 'clientId' are present and valid.

methods.name: validateModifyLoanApplication
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for modifying a loan application, with optional checks for 'loanType' and 'clientId'.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfReqd
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are unsupported parameters detected.

methods.name: validateTemplate
methods.description: Adds 'template' to unsupported parameters if the request is a template.
